title: Subscriptions and Memberships: Plans, Sign-up and Agreements | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Some things are not bought once: software, courses and clubs bill every month or year, and customers expect to start, pause and cancel on their own. The CrestApps Subscriptions module turns a product into a plan that bills again by itself, gives subscribers access through roles while they are paid, and keeps a record of every subscription. Memberships make a product put its buyer in a role for a number of days.

In this video:
• Why subscriptions and memberships, and how the screens fit together
• Plan types and plans: billing duration, initial amount, billing cycle limit, free trial days and member access
• Signing up to a plan from the Plans page, with or without an account
• Agreements: every subscription, its status, and how to cancel or pause it
• Subscription settings: guest sign-up, currency and default roles
• Memberships: the roles and the days a membership lasts
